items.name: materials-styles
items.title: Starlight materials styles
items.description: DESIGN.md tokens as CSS custom properties and a Tailwind 4 theme, plus the glass tiers and the state contract's preference rules. Import materials.css from your global stylesheet after Tailwind.
items.docs: Add to your global CSS, after @import "tailwindcss": @import "@/components/starlight-materials/styles/materials.css";

items.name: material
items.title: Material contract
items.description: The material prop type and the one shared state contract (press depth, visible focus ring, hover only inside hover: hover and pointer: fine).

items.name: glass-gate
items.title: Glass gate
items.description: gpuPlan(), the 8 ms frame budget, and the SSR-safe useGlassPlan() hook that decides CSS or WebGL on the reader's device and preferences.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: Glass surface
items.description: The glass material: a poster and a CSS-blurred panel with no script, upgraded to a three.js refraction pass only when the gate says webgl and a 12-frame probe stays under 8 ms. Pauses off screen; one teardown.
items.docs: Relative imports between the installed files use .ts extensions; set allowImportingTsExtensions: true in tsconfig (Next.js has noEmit, so it is allowed). Needs the @starlight namespace in components.json registries, which resolves glass-gate, material and materials-styles.

items.name: material-button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn button with a material prop (glass, paper, ink) and the shared state contract. 44px pill by default.

items.name: material-card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn card with a material prop and an interactive flag that opts a card into the state contract.

items.name: material-sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: shadcn sheet with a material prop, 100dvh side sheets, safe-area padding on the edge it touches, and touch-action on its own axis only.
